arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Monthly net excise taxes for FY 2018 (Oct 2017 - Sept 2018) in millions of dollars
values = [7463, 7240, 6867, 6168, 5878, 7849, 6905, 7325, 7343, 7716, 8154, 16079]

# Calculate Mean
mean = sum(values) / len(values)
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate absolute deviations from mean
abs_deviations = [abs(v - mean) for v in values]
print(f"Absolute deviations: {abs_deviations}")

# Calculate MAD (Mean Absolute Deviation)
mad = sum(abs_deviations) / len(abs_deviations)
print(f"\nMAD: {mad}")
print(f"MAD rounded to thousandths: {mad:.3f}")
EOF
